title: fix(app-shell): the Studio Validations editor says why it is read-only, to hover and to the keyboard (objectui#12691)
body:
Fixes #12691
Clause-②: no

## What

On a read-only package, the Studio Data pillar's Validations rule editor disabled every control (type, name, label, message, the rule's own settings, runs-on, severity, priority, enabled) and gave no reason: no tooltip, no `title`, no `aria-describedby`, and Tab skipped the whole editor.

The rule editor body now gets the same treatment objectui#12303 gave the Field properties rail (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, the rail body described by `fieldRailReasonId`):

- on a read-only package, the body is a `role="group"` tab stop, named by the panel title ("Validation rules");
- it is described by a visually hidden copy of the existing `engine.studio.pkg.readonlyHint` row, so screen readers announce the reason;
- it is the trigger of a tooltip that shows the reason, so hovering any disabled control in it, or tabbing to it, shows "Read-only package — switch to or create a writable package to edit." (zh: the existing Chinese row).

The editor gets one reason, not one per control. Every control is disabled for the same reason, and a disabled control gets no pointer or focus events, so a per-control tooltip would never fire. That is why objectui#12303 wrapped the rail body, and this reuses that pattern rather than adding a second one. The controls stay disabled, and a writable package renders exactly as before.

Only `ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx` changes. The panel already has the locale and its `disabled` flag, so the mount in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` is untouched. No export, prop or language-pack key is added.

## Tests

`ObjectValidationsPanel.readOnlyReason-12691.test.tsx`, 7 tests:
- en-US and zh-CN: the body is described by the reason and named by the panel title, and holds at least 6 disabled controls;
- en-US and zh-CN: hovering the disabled Severity picker opens a tooltip with the reason;
- en-US and zh-CN: Tab from the rule list lands on the described body, and the tooltip opens;
- CONTROL: on a writable package there is no reason, no `aria-describedby`, and the controls are enabled.

Ablation: with the panel swapped back to its `33ee9de` blob, the run gave `Tests 6 failed | 1 passed (7)` (only the CONTROL stayed green). Restored from HEAD: the hash equals the HEAD blob and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

Every test family naming `ObjectValidationsPanel`, `readonlyHint`, `ReadOnlyReason` or `StudioDesignSurface` passes on head `700571b`: `Test Files 182 passed (182)`, `Tests 1518 passed (1518)`.

Local gates on `700571b`, all exit 0: app-shell dependency build plus `type-check`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:changeset-claims`, `changeset:check`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, eslint on the changed files (0 errors; 1 warning in code this diff does not touch).

## Live reading

Backend from `e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh`: published `@objectstack/cli@18.0.0-next.2`, showcase at `e5136ff10f1a`. Console vite dev server on this branch. Page `/studio/com.example.showcase/data?surface=object%3Ashowcase_task`, Validations tab, rule "Task Status Flow":

- before (base panel): hovering Severity shows no tooltip; Tab from the rule list lands on `BODY`.
- after: hovering Severity shows the reason tooltip; Tab lands on the editor group, which is described by the reason and opens the tooltip.

Screenshots are on branch `claude/issue-12691-evidence`, under `evidence/12691/`.

## Acceptance notes

- The tooltip uses `side="left"`, as the objectui#12303 rail does. In this two-pane layout it sits over the top of the rule list while it is open.
- Outside this card's surface, not measured: the Settings, Hooks and Actions panels get the same `disabled` at their mounts. Whether they state a reason was not read here.
